sourceAdaptations.subject: Activation
sourceAdaptations.detail: One actual Tools/windows/UiaWindowActivation.cs is linked by the shared production library. Test-only operations implement that same interface in a separate namespace.

sourceAdaptations.subject: Input and popup
sourceAdaptations.detail: Complete actual gate helper delegates to one UiaInputSafety instance. Only static-to-instance native receiver calls and shared interop types moved; policy bodies, diagnostics and observation order remain shared with typed operation-only fixtures.

sourceAdaptations.subject: Source guards
sourceAdaptations.detail: 39 original literal observations target explicit current consumed production files. Legacy patterns and receiver-only changes are retained beside each assertion. Sleep ABI/policy and Unicode clear/read/call/record creation checks are split across explicit sources without relying on declaration order.

sourceAdaptations.subject: Delete context source correspondence
sourceAdaptations.detail: The frozen legacy source predicate expected direct PostContextMenu and Wait-ForPopupMenu calls. The actual frozen Cards gate already used Open-CanvasCardContextMenu. The migrated guard verifies its actual stable-identity callsite plus foreground, owner, visibility, finite clipped geometry, owned right-click, nonzero popup, enabled command ID, Cancel and teardown. All five original mutant obligations are retained against real current anchors.

sourceAdaptations.subject: No legacy execution
sourceAdaptations.detail: The exported blocked runner is a read-only case oracle, never an executed, extracted or embedded payload. Focused PS adapters are independently authored; only named actual production gate functions are invoked where PS scope, AST, ScriptProperty or ErrorRecord semantics are under test.

sourceAdaptations.subject: Evidence boundaries
sourceAdaptations.detail: Four activation,21 input,10 popup predicate,9 source,11 effect,14 hidden native lookup and6 hidden native hit cases remain explicit. No claim is made for native02, unrelated GUI walkthroughs, macOS parity, or a full host green while other mandatory families remain incomplete.
